businessUrls.title: Trustpilot business review URLs
businessUrls.description: One or more Trustpilot business review URLs. Example: https://www.trustpilot.com/review/booking.com

businessUrl.title: Single business URL (alternative)
businessUrl.description: Single Trustpilot business URL. Used only if businessUrls is empty.

maxReviews.title: Maximum reviews per business
maxReviews.description: Hard cap per business. Prevents runaway charges on businesses with tens of thousands of reviews.

filterByStars.title: Filter by star rating
filterByStars.description: Only return reviews with these star ratings. Valid values: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5. Leave empty for all ratings.

language.title: Language filter
language.description: Only return reviews in this language. Leave empty for all languages. Example: en, fr, de, es
